thread:
Anya: Quick follow-up from this morning's ETL hiccup \u2014 observed recurring span-loss and aggregator count drift across two windows. Need explicit owners and short/long term fixes.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0502-11 created; alerts routed to #eng-oncall.
Eli: Consumer lag started rising at ~03:20 UTC, coinciding with compaction jobs. Reprocessing overlapped and caused CPU contention.
Sam: Hot-shard from session bucketing change likely; some partitions hit 8-12x expected load and KV cache started evicting.
Priya: I'll own a short-term mitigation: add bounded in-memory buffer + backpressure; ETA 6h to staging. Owner=Priya.
Anya: Priya add a dashboard tile for buffer occupancy and reprocess rate. Owner=Priya, due=1966010000.
Eli: I'll implement weighted hashing and a feature-flagged revert of the bucketing tweak. ETA 36h dev + 12h canary. Owner=Eli.
Sam: For correctness, propose per-window CRC and nightly diff against source-of-truth. I can draft the job. Owner=Sam, due=1966080000.
Anya: Alerts: trigger if span-drop-rate >0.05% over 10m or aggregator delta >1% for two consecutive windows. Update runbook with rollback steps.
Priya: Pushed staging config: consumer.max_inflight=180, buffering.ms=100. Monitoring green so far.
Eli: I'll post PR for weighted hashing by EOD and include a load-sim test.
Anya: Action recap: Priya (buffer + dashboard), Eli (weighted hashing + revert), Sam (checksums + nightly diff), ops (alert thresholds + runbook). Put PR links in the follow-up doc and update the remediation spreadsheet when done.
ops-bot: Follow-up sync scheduled at 1966013600 UTC \u2014 agenda: deploy plan, validation checks, rollback criteria.
Anya: Thanks team. One-line updates here if you hit blockers.
